response.summary: The evidence supports the close candidate on every predicate. The plan text before §12 hashes to the approved r2 digest 76ddbb2b, so the amendments keep the approved criteria. The D1 narrowing follows the owner's D1b ruling in the SI1 spec. The shard sums in both lane receipts match the stated totals: 22,146 and 22,149. release-tag.txt shows the annotated tag 9d1021d8 peeling to merge 9c051d52. That merge's second parent is the tested head c89e55e6, and the merge differs from it only by the two PR #312 planning documents. The Rmap timing test is unmarked and falls in shard 3 under the runner's file-index%6 assignment. Nothing blocks the close. The three remaining hardening concerns are: RC-02 has no named residual target, the corrected lane quietly changes the uv toolchain, and the predicate-6 digest and review-helper claims have no recorded receipt. A fourth point, that a single passing run disposes the intermittent timing question, is folded into the RC-02 concern.
The named artifacts match their digests. The phase records, test-lane receipts, merge and tag verification, plan amendments, and question sweep support the close candidate; no concerns found.

response.summary: All three digests match. Predicates 1-6 trace to their records: the SI1 spec holds before/after route matrices with validate and check rows and a flat-file plus fabricated-include cell set (T5), and the record claims exit 3 with flattening:re-entry and the conditional unattended:flat-without-root diagnostic; SI2 binds delegated reading C with the 436-model identity digest unchanged; SI3 records 17 deltas with 8-to-0 and 5-to-0 counts, oracle passes and the round trip; SI4 and the remote receipt bind the annotated tag object peeling to merge 9c051d52. The lane receipts sum consistently (initial 22,146 passes with the three red checks disclosed; corrected 22,149, all six shard exits 0, uv 0.10.10), and the merge-versus-tested-tree difference is characterized in the tag receipt as two induction-skill planning paths plus a 226-test merged-checkout gate. Plan section 12 amendments preserve the approved predicates while recording the D1 and C2 corrections, and the question sweep disposes every row with evidence or a named maintenance target. Two advisory concerns remain: the full lane covers the PR-head tree rather than the tagged merge tree with the equivalence summarized instead of bound in the close artifact, and the SI3 corpus count is unreconciled with the plan measurement.

criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the planned software would not demonstrably do what the plan claims. Do not manufacture completeness concerns to avoid an empty return -- "no concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.
Judge whether the close candidate supports each completed predicate using the named measurements and phase records. Flag a missing gate or evidence that covers different bytes than the claim.

Check the original and corrected test lanes, the scope of the merge difference, and the annotated tag evidence. Review the scope of the corrected lane and the higher project threshold of four successful seats.
Check that the plan amendments preserve the approved criteria and that the question sweep disposes the phase questions with evidence or a named residual target.
Cite one concrete location in a requested artifact for each concern. Consult directly relevant evidence only as needed. Make one focused pass without delegation, builds or tests.
